description: Declarative classification rules for Warwickshire County Council spending rows. Applied to the Oracle Fusion transparency feed (Apr 2011 – Mar 2026, 1.149M rows). Warwickshire publishes raw GL codes (R-codes, C-codes) rather than human category names, so accrual detection is not yet possible from source data — all rows fall through to procurement_paid unless they match one of the artefact rules below. Derived from Phase 1 audit 2026-04-19 (see investigations/SOURCE_AUDIT_2026-04-19.md).

rules.reason: 33,034 rows / £57M. Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions on ASC Direct Payments, foster-carer / SGO allowances, CYP Direct Payments, Staying Put arrangements. Lawfully unnamed — not third-party procurement.
494 rows / £36M. Employer contribution to LGPS fund administered by WCC itself. Money moving inside the council group, not external procurement.

match.supplier_regex: ^(NUNEATON & BEDWORTH BOROUGH COUNCIL|WARWICK DISTRICT COUNCIL|STRATFORD ON AVON DISTRICT COUNCIL|RUGBY BOROUGH COUNCIL(?: \(\*+\d+\))?|NORTH WARWICKSHIRE BOROUGH COUNCIL(?: \(\*+\d+\))?)$

rules.reason: County→district pass-throughs: Disabled Facilities Grant allocations (statutory under HGCR Act 1996 s.23), concessionary travel reimbursements (Transport Act 2000 s.149), BCF s.75 pooled budget transfers. WCC has no procurement discretion over these flows — they are formula-driven statutory passes to the lower tier.

match.supplier_regex: ^(COVENTRY AND WARWICKSHIRE PARTNERSHIP NHS TRUST|SOUTH WARWICKSHIRE NHS FOUNDATION TRUST(?:\*+\d+)?|SOUTH WARWICKSHIRE UNIVERSITY NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|NHS WARWICKSHIRE NORTH CCG|NHS SOUTH WARWICKSHIRE CCG|NHS COVENTRY AND WARWICKSHIRE ICB)$

rules.reason: BCF s.75 pooled budget transfers to NHS commissioning bodies + trust reimbursements for jointly-commissioned services (Section 75 NHS Act 2006). Legally ring-fenced.

aliases: BALFOUR BEATTY LIVING PLACES LTD (HMC16 CERT 001)
supplier_aliases.reason: Highways term-maintenance contractor. Warwickshire's Oracle Fusion ledger splits the same legal entity across 6+ masked supplier IDs (£572M combined across top 4 variants). Canonicalise for HHI + top-supplier rankings.
